What a Fitted Score-Driven Term Reports

Source: R/gas.R
term_readable.GasTerm.Rd

The level, the score loadings and the AUTOREGRESSIVE COEFFICIENTS of the literature – omega, alpha1, beta1 – with the Jacobian from the term's own parameters.

Arguments

term

A GasTerm.

zeta

The parameters on the unconstrained scale.

...

Unused.

Value

A list, as term_readable documents.

Details

The level and the loadings are reported through their own links, each a function of its own coordinate alone, which the base method already does. The persistence is not: it is carried on a partial autocorrelation, and the coefficients come from the Levinson-Durbin recursion, whose Jacobian the term already computes for the filter. Chained onto the rhobit link of each coordinate, that Jacobian is what a delta-method standard error for \(\beta_j\) needs. At \(q = 1\) the two coincide and the chain factor is the link's alone; above it they do not.

A deviation is reported as it stands, being unconstrained and defined on the scale of the parameter it departs from.
